@gallifreyone At last year's #Gally1, an incredible #MeToo moment unfolded on stage. On Saturday at 3pm, I'll be leading a panel to 
follow up on that moment and talk about practical steps our community can take to support cast and crew in the entertainment industry. https://t.co/ouf7abEXg2

If you are coming to the #MeToo panel at #Gally1, but weren't here for last year's panel, here's my recap of that moment: https://t.co/KV23eR19F6
You should also read @rtalalay's piece about what it was like on stage: https://t.co/OqNxXlyzen
I'm moderating a panel discussion about last year's #MeToo moment at #Gally1 today at 3pm in Program B (the room on the lobby level). Add it to your Sched here: https://t.co/ouf7abEXg2

If you weren't here last year to see the #MeToo moment unfold at the "Gallifrey Waits No More" panel, my write-up details what happens and provides context for today's discussion: https://t.co/KV23eR19F6

If you attended the #MeToo panel at #gally1 and need additional support, here are resources that may be helpful for you:
RAINN’s National Sexual Assault Hotline: 800-656-4673
Additional hotlines and legal resources:
https://t.co/Cp848fGvhM 
https://t.co/xZfDWYY8AU
Ly, you are amazing and your courage to share your story on the #MeToo panel at #Gally1 left me in awe. Thank you so much for speaking out. 💙💙
Please read this remarkable reckoning from @InquiringJoy. She is so brave to share her story, and everyone should read it. #MeToo

@InquiringJoy This isn't about public shaming or calling out. This is an opportunity for everyone to reckon with their own behavior — to understand how abusers operate, how they attempt to manipulate communities to enable their behavior, and how we can and must support survivors. #MeToo
